name: Eyes & the dark

overlay.caption: pupils open in seconds · light-sensing cells rebuild their pigment over minutes

does: Shows pupils opening fully within seconds
Shows the eye's sensitivity to dim light climbing for many minutes — fastest at first
Shows that coming in from brighter light means starting further behind
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Separate the cone cells (colour, bright light) from the rod cells (dim light)
Say anything about problems seeing at night
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: If you find it unusually hard to see in dim light, tell an adult.

sources: NIH National Eye Institute: How the eyes work (student pages)
